newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude traders bullish but wary.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude traders bullish but wary.

text.p: NYMEX crude oil futures were expected to open slightly firmer on Wednesday and traders and technical analysts said they expected some recovery from Tuesday's sharp falls.

NYMEX June crude, the new front month, closed 48 cents a barrel weaker on Tuesday at $19.59, while May heating oil was 0.69 cent a gallon weaker at 54.83 cents and May gasoline was 1.03 cents down at 61.77 cents.

"I am cautiously optimistic," said Omar Gadsby at MCM in London. "I was encouraged by the price action yesterday which was a very weak close, but the overall picture of the last couple of weeks suggests that the short-term base at $19.08 is intact."
The $19.08 level represents the low point of this month's trading range. It was touched on April 4 and retested a couple of times since then.
"One thing I am concerned about, however, is the dark cloud cover after yesterday's trade. That is not an encouraging sign," Gadsby said. (c) Reuters Limited 1997
